20260501223739.label: a small omen
20260501223739.text: The floor remembers its old arrangement and will whisper warnings when something important falls in the wrong place.
20260501223739.title: The Archaeology of Your Floor

20260501231137.label: a permission slip
20260501231137.text: Your voice has marked that page as a threshold—return to it when you need proof you can choose differently.
20260501231137.title: The Page That Chose You

20260502183728.label: a strange compliment
20260502183728.text: You've learned to harmonize with the world's ignored frequencies, and now machines briefly mistake you for one of their own.
20260502183728.title: The Song Your Appliances Are Already Singing
